notes: ci_certified: the deterministic certification harness (apps/web/tests/shopify-certification.test.ts) passes in CI, exercising the real port stack over a simulated Shopify transport across all required scenarios.
live_dev_store_certified: set to true ONLY after an owner completes tools/shopify-live-cert.mjs against a real Shopify development store (see LIVE_CERTIFICATION.md) and reviews the generated report.
Unrestricted production writeback (WRITEBACK_SAFETY_MODE=production) must remain disabled until live_dev_store_certified is true. Default stays dev_store_only.
